shortDescription: Manage replication consistency groups on Dell PowerFlex

options.name: activity_mode
options.description: Activity mode of RCG. This parameter is supported for version 3.6 and above.

options.name: create_snapshot
options.description: Whether to create the snapshot of the replication consistency group.

options.name: force
options.description: Force switchover the RCG.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: is_consistent
options.description: Consistency of RCG.

options.name: new_rcg_name
options.description: Name of RCG to rename to.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: pause_mode
options.description: Pause mode. It is required if pause is set as true.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: protection_domain_id
options.description: Protection domain id. Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_name).

options.name: protection_domain_name
options.description: Protection domain name. Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_id).

options.name: rcg_id
options.description: The ID of the replication consistency group. Mutually exclusive with I(rcg_name).

options.name: rcg_name
options.description: The name of the replication consistency group. It is unique across the PowerFlex array. Mutually exclusive with I(rcg_id).

options.name: rcg_state
options.description: Specify an action for RCG. Failover the RCG. Reverse the RCG. Restore the RCG. Switchover the RCG. Pause or resume the RCG. Freeze or unfreeze the RCG. Synchronize the RCG.

options.name: remote_peer
options.description: Remote peer system.

options.name: rpo
options.description: Desired RPO in seconds.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the replication consistency group.

options.name: target_volume_access_mode
options.description: Target volume access mode.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
